title: On Real-Time Feasibility of High-Rate MPC using an Active-Set Method on Nano-Quadcopters
summary: Deploying Model Predictive Control on nano-scale aerial platforms is challenging due to the severe computational limitations of onboard microcontrollers. This paper presents an experimental study with computational focus of a dual active-set solver (DAQP) applied to the low-level control of a Crazyflie 2.1 nano-quadcopter. Unlike previous approaches that utilize first-order methods for low-level stabilization or restrict active-set solvers to high-level control, this work demonstrates the successful deployment of a dual active-set method executing at 500 Hz on an STM32F405 microcontroller.…
